interface.rationale: Retired Lines and Point Connect from picker and Home, preserving safe route/query/snapshot fallback. Existing fonts, palette, disclosure semantics and input filtering remain. Chromium and WebKit keyboard/mobile checks and measured About contrast passed.

bar-and-exports.rationale: Read official geometry and Pattern guidance. Owner chose 21 solid steps with width ratio 2:1 on November 18 after scientific clarification. Fixed geometry, one ink, no opacity blending or fitted edges. Shared preview/header/GIF geometry; existing resting SVG/PNG semantics retained. Extremely narrow steps are honestly documented as subpixel at normal raster size.

media.rationale: Read all contextual media sources. Only two existing Gradient SVG samples and original application review captures change. No production video, photo, audio, seal or spirit mark is introduced; their permissions and video typography conflict remain outside this change.

assets-and-approvals.rationale: Read asset_licensing.md and its actual unresolved permission records. Gradient samples are original software-authored rectangles, not copied Xyla artwork. Screenshots reuse existing project assets. No fonts, logos, external artwork or licenses are added or replaced; existing redistribution questions remain open.

governance.rationale: Read all 17 captured pages and source coverage/manifest. Record the owner’s narrowly scoped November 18 product decision in brand_conflicts.md without altering official sources, checks or claiming formal approval.

Circles Gradient and Artemis artwork are unchanged. Other B01–B10 boundaries remain unchanged, with no new asset, lockup, palette or permission assumption.

Existing formal RPI approval questions remain open.
